cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Enter on My Side
cards.instruction: Recruit them into your side of a contest or bargain before the stakes become fully clear.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Back my stall at the fete. Sign here above 'joint entrant.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What's the penalty clause below it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. The sort of challenge best discussed between partners.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly why I've left a convenient space for your name.
